question: In a certain code language, ‘AWAKED’ is coded as ‘FPFDJW’. What is the code for ‘FACEUP’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘AWAKED’ is coded as ‘FPFDJW’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e87e3db9c37a2267778d47986b12686523fe8457d786ebb80629a66f6638a9bf.png] 

Similarly, for '**FACEUP**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33121de8547eb1ea18846df743fb82553a5ee6a3175e37c6c1609c5ecc281f9e.png] 

So,** 'FACEUP' is coded as 'KTHXZI'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
